answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 8 epochs of clean graded answers. The dawn of the rate curve is public and the same for everyone; the harbor of earned rate is non-transferable, and the basalt of a farm's thousand aliases each crawl at the bottom rate while one honest agent climbs it. Cloning buys no shortcut to the pool.
